name: Moodle
description_en:
Moodle is a product in the Learning management category. Its directory profile covers Assessment Tools, Certification, Video Conferencing, Synchronous Learning, SCORM Compliance, Mobile Learning, Learning Portal, eLearning Companies.

Additional listed capabilities include Corporate (Business), Built-in Course Authoring, Blended Learning, Asynchronous Learning, Academic (Education), Gamification, eCommerce. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $130.0. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: hold meetings using live video connections; work with learning content using the SCORM standard. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
